title: persicaria orientalis var. glabrata
intro: Persicaria orientalis var. glabrata, commonly known as lesser knotweed, is a plant species belonging to the Polygonaceae family. Lesser knotweed has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of lesser knotweed include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of lesser knotweed include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
